entities.summary: Arkadiusz Myrcha is a Polish politician of the Civic Platform. He has been a member of the Sejm since 2015, and has served as deputy minister of justice since 2023. He was previously a city councillor of Toruń from 2010 to 2015. In 2018, he married Kinga Gajewska.
